findings.unchangedDelivery: Existing final-assessment/application queue and release binding remain. Source GO does not attest source installation or authorize a duplicate final assessment/application.

recovery.authorizedPlan: Stop the existing host service, recheck waiting with corrected bound readiness and no explicit stop, then restore only this same pre-dispatch job to waiting while preserving the cancelled snapshot and recovery provenance. Retain exact identifiers, package and protocol. Resume retained PREPARE6 through the existing revise_digital/resume route; no new request, evaluation, task-state rewrite or reset.

conclusion: GO for the exact source delta and stated same-job pre-dispatch recovery conditions.
